Rundeer Attack10 Off Road Electric Bike

Flagship Power Meets Certified Safety - The Rundeer Attack 10 redefines what a off-road electric bike can be—with a refined balance of high-output power, certified safety, and long-range capability. BAFANG 1200W peak rear-drive motor delivers class-leading torque for instant acceleration, stable hill climbing, and off-road reliability. Torque-optimized for 30 mph top speeds, this is not a toy—it’s a street-legal performance machine built for serious riders.

Fully compliant with 2849 (e-bike electrical system safety) and 2271 (battery safety), the Attack 10 is engineered for U.S. regulatory environments and built to withstand the real-world rigors of adventure, commuting, and daily use.

Battery with Extended Range - At the core is a 960Wh lithium-ion battery, built with Samsung cells, delivering reliable power output and consistent thermal performance. Ride up to 68 miles on a single charge under PAS mode (range varies by terrain, weight, and usage). The battery is certified, lockable, IP65 waterproof-rated, and removable for convenient indoor charging. Recharge fully in just 5–6 hours, making it ready again before the next ride begins.

Advanced Full Suspension for All-Terrain Comfort - Built on a magnesium alloy monocoque frame crafted with integrated pressure-casting technology, the Attack 10 is rugged yet lightweight. The dual-crown front fork (160mm travel) impact across dirt, gravel, and pavement, translating to real-world performance you can feel. Whether launching off trailheads or navigating pothole-ridden city blocks, the suspension is tuned for maximum rider control and minimum fatigue.

Elite Braking & Smart Control System - 20x4” puncture-resistant all-terrain fat tires give the Attack 10 a planted, stable ride posture across soft sand, loose rock, and tarmac. Tektro hydraulic disc brakes offer consistent, modulated braking force even during high-speed descents or in wet weather. Paired with a 5-level pedal assist system, 7-speed Shimano gearing, and twist throttle mode, you’re always in command—whether crawling uphill or cruising the boardwalk.

Easy Installation & Warranty - Delivered 90% pre-assembled with all tools and an intuitive guide, the Attack 10 gets you on the road faster. All bikes include 12-month limited warranty coverage.
